text:
mira: quick sync — proposal for a micro smoke of "early-accept" speculative flow on aurora-13b-4q. goal: verify simple speedups without big regression risk.

alex: outline?

mira: plan:
- draft model: aurora-13b-4q, greedy fastpath
- verifier: aurora-13b-fp16
- mechanism: early-accept when draft prefix logits stable for T tokens (stability window) OR logit-gap > G
- initial params: stability_window=3, logit_gap=9.0

jeff: stability-window is new vs our usual single-token gate. why 3?

mira: two reasons: reduces ping-pong when model flips decisions; gives better precision for multi-token phrases. we'll sweep 1..5.

dan: eval set and size?

mira: tiny smoke: 180 prompts (60 QA-short, 60 long-summ, 60 instruction-chains). will reuse onboarding seeds and exact prompts so diffing easy.

alex: metrics to capture:
- token p50/p90
- request p50/p90
- early-accept % (how often we avoid verify)
- stepwise error: phrases where early-accept caused wrong continuation (we'll flag)
- LLM-judge acceptability
- topk QA accuracy and rouge for summaries

jeff: run knobs: stability_window, logit_gap, kv_cache on/off, stream on/off. save raw logits for first 40 items.

mira: infra request: small dedicated for stable timing. prefer 2h slot.

quant-bot: dedicated slot request queued: "eng-ml-micro" 2h. ETA 9m. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

mira: quick run command for local harness:

```
python tools/early_accept_smoke.py \
  --draft aurora-13b-4q \
  --verify aurora-13b-fp16 \
  --stability_window 3 \
  --logit_gap 9.0 \
  --prompts smoke_180.json \
  --kv_cache on \
  --stream false \
  --out results/early_accept_7135799999.json
```

dan: decision rules?

mira: if median token latency reduction >=12% and judge drop <=1% -> expand sweep. If judge drop 1-3% -> hand inspect top 20 failures. >3% -> stop.

jeff: also add a quick heuristic check for repeated tokens/truncation — early-accept might cut off mid-phrase.

mira: good call. run will log sequence lengths and truncation flags.

mira: starting now. will post summary table in ~25m. tagging @alex @dan @jeff :rocket:
